scope: Fixed core medium-fi exterior with explicitly approximate hidden detail.

quallaSearch.notes: The Qualla corpus was checked first. Its cleared historic aerial establishes the open D-shaped masonry ring but predates the restored porch and kiosks; plaque images and historic aquarium views are not modern exterior coverage. The exact official NPS staff originals now cover the main entrance and restored inner portico/casemates.

originalReview.notes: Exact3072x2048original inspected: frontal rusticated portal, through-door, surrounding brownstone and chimney cap; entrance sign excluded.
Exact3072x2048original inspected: restored straight pale wood porch, brick wall openings, curved casemate roof and brick piers.
Exact3072x2048official original inspected: historical unrestored D-ring and portals only; not a present roof/courtyard control.
